The company’s performance in Q2 2015 demonstrates a worrisome trend with concerning drops in revenue, profitability, and asset base. The decrease in equity is a particularly alarming sign. While some expense management improvements exist, they are not enough to offset the revenue shortfall.  The ratio analysis underscores the declining profitability and reduced efficiency.
